title: Amazon Kinesis: real-time streaming data

kcs.statement: Amazon Kinesis collects and processes streaming data such as clickstreams, IoT telemetry and application logs in real time, making records available to consumers within about a second.

Kinesis Data Streams keeps ordered records for custom consumer applications to read and replay; Amazon Data Firehose (formerly Kinesis Data Firehose) delivers a stream into destinations such as S3, Redshift or OpenSearch with no code.
With Kinesis several consumers can read the same records and replay them within the retention window, whereas an SQS message is deleted once one consumer processes it.
